description: v2.1.0 section 9.3, PROJECT — a definition-time reference to a named export declared on a source offense (e.g. PROJECT(injury, result) refers to injury's exports.result). PROJECT itself is a mechanical structural-reuse utility, not a legal constructor. 2026-08-08 review: this object only records source_offense + export_key, i.e. exactly what a human author writes and what COMPOSE component lists point at. The concrete predicate/expression id that export_key actually resolves to (what an earlier draft called 'resolved_ref') is compiler-computed the same way DerivedOffenseDef.flattened_elements is (see derived_offense_def.schema.json) — it belongs to the compiled IR produced by step 4 (QUALIFY/COMPOSE compiler), not to this Definition Layer object, so authoring it here would create a second, potentially stale source of truth for the same fact.

source_offense.description: The OffenseDef (or DerivedOffenseDef) id this projects from.

export_key.description: The key under the source offense's 'exports' map, e.g. 'result'. Not restricted to fixed_slot_name because an offense may export a named sub-expression rather than a whole slot. The compiler resolves source_offense + export_key to a concrete predicate/expression id at compile time (step 4) — that resolved id is compiled-IR output, MUST NOT be independently authored in this Definition Layer YAML.
